Chup rehna samajhdaari ki nishani hai.
Khamoshi spashtata lati hai.
Grit bardasht ke baare mein hai.
Humein brothers jaise saath rehna seekhna chahiye—warna fools ki tarah saath perish.
Mann ki khamoshi mein, dil ki awaaz sunai deti hai.
Grit future ke liye tough love hai.
Grit setbacks ko setups banata.
Grit mushkilon mein mazboot banta hai.
Sher ki dahad tez hoti hai, lekin uska chup rehna daravna hota hai.
Gusse ka sabse behtareen jawab khamoshi hai.
Khali bartan sabse zyada shor karte hain.
Courage—fear ka na hona nahi, uske bawajood act karne ki ability.
Grit matlab har roz aana.
Necessary ho to alone khade rehna courage.
Khamoshi buddhimani hai.
Hum woh nahi jo jaante—hum woh jo seekhne ko ready hain.
Grit mushkil cheezein lagatar karna.
Shaant dimag mein gehra grit hota hai.
